metadata.title: Where are the Old-Population High Velocity Stars?

notes: No eligible individual stars: the paper proposes and evaluates a survey strategy for a hypothetical old HVS population and does not select or analyze a particular star as a Galactic-unbound candidate. The named US 708 at T:p1-b7 is cited only as a prior discovery, not followed up or analyzed here; the estimated old-HVS yield at T:p1-b3 and T:p5-b13 is population-level and has no individual star identifiers.
